trans-unit.source: Administers which backend users and groups can access and edit pages in the site tree. For each page, an owner user and group can be assigned, and read, write, and edit permissions defined. These settings control who can view or modify content within the page hierarchy.
trans-unit.target: This is where you gatekeep which backend homies and squads can access and glow up pages in the site tree. For each page, you can assign a main character and a squad, plus set lurk, post, and glow up clout. These settings control who can vibe with content in the page hierarchy, no cap.
